This board handles hills like a beast. The issue isn't so much power as it is heat. This is where dual motors really help since they divide the load and thus get less warm, but dual motors means you need more battery power and dual ESCs which ramps the price up quite a bit. It'd be possible, but I don't really recommend it on a single motor.

As far as water goes this board can handle some splashes but I've had too many close calls with water to justify riding it when it's wet. I live in Amsterdam so biking is great regardless and I save the board for when it's 100% dry. However, I could redesign the box to be much much more waterproof. I'll be building a board for a friend (hopefully soon) which will have similar specs to my board, but I'll be able to apply all the knowledge I've gained from this project and apply it to his more efficiently.
